verdict.rationale: Green and Spiegel is an immigration law firm offering consultations and legal representation, not a software product, so performing bulk operations across many items is a category error for this kind of offering. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships any software, API, or self-serve tool that would make the axis apply; the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes both returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
